ideas.title: Investigation into DHS fraud allegations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the fraud allegations within DHS and the retirement of Deputy Commissioner Shireen Gandhi amid these allegations.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the extent of the fraud allegations within DHS.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud allegations?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves potential misuse of public funds and the retirement of a high-ranking official amid allegations.

ideas.title: Taco Bell cyclosporiasis outbreak
ideas.description: This story would investigate the cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to Taco Bell and the ongoing CDC investigation.
ideas.angle: Investigate the source of the outbreak and Taco Bell's response.
questions: What is the source of the outbreak?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it affects public health and food safety.
